description.value:
Requirement You are wielding two firearms.

Duration constant

Reduce your multiple attack penalty by 1 on the second and subsequent ranged Strikes you make in a turn while wielding two firearms. This does not stack with agile or with any other effect that reduces the multiple attack penalty; use whichever is better.

cinderfall.incomplete: The toggle above is player-set (turn it on while dual-wielding two firearms, off otherwise) rather than automatically detected -- Foundry has no built-in roll option for "currently wielding two weapons" to predicate against directly, confirmed by search; this is the same manual-tracking convention this corpus already uses for other stance-like toggles. The card's own "doesn't stack with agile/other MAP reduction" clause is not separately enforced -- MultipleAttackPenalty's real stacking behavior (lowest value applies) already produces the correct outcome without an explicit suppression rule, so nothing further was needed there.
